title: Tamil, Telugu Dubs of Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill Anime Stream on Muse India
content:
The first anime season premiered by streaming exclusively in Japan on Amazon Prime Video and Hikari TV in January 2023. Muse Asia streamed the first season of the anime in India as it aired in Japan. The Muse India YouTube channel then streamed episodes of the anime with Hindi subtitles in roman script. Netflix later added the anime in India. Crunchyroll is streaming the season in India in Japanese and with an English dub . Muse India added a Hindi dub of the season in November 2024.

Kiyoshi Matsuda ( RE-MAIN , Kakegurui season 2, Uchitama?! Have you seen my Tama? ) directed the first anime season at MAPPA . Michiko Yokote ( Cowboy Bebop , Rurouni Kenshin , xxxHOLiC , Shirobako ) oversaw the series scripts, and Nao Ōtsu ( BEASTARS both seasons) adapted Masa 's original character designs for animation. Masato Kōda ( KonoSuba – God’s blessing on this wonderful world!! , Domestic Girlfriend ), Kana Utatane ( KanadeYUK ), and Kuricorder Quartet ( tsuritama ) composed the music.

The second season of Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill premiered in October 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime season in India as it aired in Japan. Muse Asia also streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan as did Netflix , Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times , and JioHotstar. Crunchyroll streamed the Hindi dub of the season on November 12 and the Tamil and Telugu dub on December 3.

Eguchi started publishing the novels on the "Shosetsuka ni Narō" website in 2016, and Overlap is publishing the novels in print. Overlap is also publishing K Akagishi 's manga adaptation in Japan, as well as Momo Futaba 's Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hōrō Meshi: Sui no Daibōken spinoff manga.

J-Novel Club is releasing both the light novel series and K Akagishi 's manga adaptation in English.

title: MMAJ Hosts Makoto Shinkai Film Dubbing Competition, Guests Luna Haruna, Daisuke Hasegawa, More in New Delhi
content:
The event will take place on October 3 and 4 at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden, New Delhi.

The Makoto Shinkai Film Dubbing Competition will take place during both days of the event, but participants must apply online by September 23.

Japanese musicians Kanapon, ERIHIRO, and Re: Like will also perform at the event.

Haruna has provided theme songs for anime such as Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend , Sword Art Online , and Fate/Zero . She launched her Lunamaria brand of wedding dresses in 2016.

Hasegawa performed a theme song for the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable anime. He has also performed a theme song and an insert song for the Gundam: Reconguista in G anime.

Mawatari has worked on the theme songs and insert songs for the 2018 Yū Yū Hakusho OVA , the Yū Yū Hakusho live-action show, Yu Yu Hakusho: Ghost Files , and more shows in the franchise .

SCREEN mode performed the opening theme song for Bungo Stray Dogs 2 — the second television anime adaptation of Kafka Asagiri and Sango Harukawa 's Bungo Stray Dogs manga — and for the original television anime Keishichō Tokumu-bu Tokushu Kyōaku-han Taisaku-Shitsu Dai-Nana-ka -Tokunana- ( Special Crime Investigation Unit Special 7 or literally, Metropolitan Police Department Special Division Heinous Crime Investigation Unit Special 7: Tokunana).

Last year's MMAJ event took place at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden, New Delhi on September 13 and 14. Haruna and Hasegawa performed at the event.

The MMAJ 2024 event took place at Pacific Mall Tagore Garden, New Delhi on September 28 and September 29. The event screened seven anime films including Suzume and Jujutsu Kaisen 0 .

title: Muse Asia Licenses Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine Anime
content:
Muse Asia announced on Thursday that it has licensed Good Smile Company 's original anime Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine (Beast King War God Dandivine), and will begin streaming it in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 7.

The anime stars:

• Takuma Terashima as Gekiha Shijima

• Haruka Shiraishi as Akane Kuzumi

• Saya Aizawa as Kirei Shijima

• Nao Tōyama as Haru

• Aya Yamane as Natsu

• Misaki Kuno as Aki

• Asuna Tomari as Gō Sera

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Yūsaku Kuroiwa

• Ryōtarō Okiayu as Daigo Shijima

• Atsushi Ono as Genjūrō Shijima

• Ruriko Aoki as Yūga Shinonome

Yi Cao is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS and Kayac Animation . Toshiki Inoue (various Kamen Rider series, Death Note ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. robin is designing the characters. Majiro ( Macross Delta ) is the original character designer. An ( GOD BRAVE STUDIO ) is the mechanical designer. Yoshikazu Iwanami ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) is the sound director.

The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets a n invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

Takanori Nishikawa is performing the opening theme song "Zankyō ≠ Blaster," and DayRe: is performing the ending theme song "Mikansei Ordinary" (Incomplete Ordinary).

TOGUCHI is drawing a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Dengeki Daioh magazine.

The anime is the first project in Good Smile Company 's "The God of Combined Series" ("Gattaishin Series"). The anime commemorates Good Smile Company 's 25th anniversary.

title: Ani-One Asia Streams FX Fighter Kurumi-chan TV Anime
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Friday that it will stream the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 1.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

University student Kurumi Fukuga finally makes her long-awaited debut in Foreign Exchange (FX) Trading, to win back the 20 million yen her late mother lost in trading. "I'll make enough in no time!" With that vow, she dives into a world that can flip from heaven to hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations... Even so, she wants to buy, sell, and make money! Will Kurumi and the others survive this raging world?

The anime stars:

• Aina Suzuki as Kurumi Fukuga

• Asami Seto as Mochiko Kogane

• Ayasa Itō as Mebuki Yamashi

• Miho Okasaki as Yasuko Takane

Yūki Ogawa ( Ōya-san wa Shishunki! , Mieruko-chan , Miru Tights ) is directing the anime at Passione . Kenta Ihara ( Blue Miburo , Sentenced to Be a Hero ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Kazuyuki Ueda ( BanG Dream! (TV 2) , Love Flops , Hinako Note ) is the character designer, and Takurō Iga ( Oshi no Ko , Trillion Game ) is composing the music.

Aina Suzuki as her character Kurumi Fukuga will perform the show's opening theme song "FX Sen shi Kurumi-chan." Suzuki will also perform the ending theme song "$・¥・€."

title: Sanrio's Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes Smartphone Game Gets Worldwide Release in Fall 2027
content:
Sanrio announced on Saturday its Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes smartphone game will get a worldwide release for iOS and Android in fall 2027. The company is streaming a new promotional video for the game.

The game will be free to play with optional in-app purchases. Ateam Holdings is developing the game with Sanrio . ANN reached out to Ateam regarding the audio and text languages available for the global version of the game, but the company did not respond by press time.

The 18 Knights of Fragaria are divided into three units : Red Bouquet, Blue Bouquet, and Noir Bouquet.

In 2016, the Sanrio Danshi were introduced as a group of boys who love Sanrio products. Sanrio Danshi inspired an anime in 2017.

title: ATASHIn'CHI Next Net Anime Gets New Episodes
content:
Shinei Animation announced at the ABEMA Anime Matsuri 2026 event on Saturday that ATASHIn'CHI Next , the latest net anime for the ATASHIn'CHI franchise, will get a new batch of episodes. Taku Kimura ( Chainsmoker Cat ) will direct the anime. Shinei Animation revealed a teaser video for the anime here (the video is not embeddable).

The first batch of five episodes of the anime debuted with a monthly schedule per episode from June to October 2024.

The next batch of five new episodes debuted on November 20, December 20, January 20, February 20, and March 20.

The anime commemorates the 30th anniversary of Eiko Kera 's original manga. The series animates stories in the original manga that were not adapted in the previous anime.

The manga inspired a television anime series that aired from 2002 to 2009. The ATASHIn'CHI film premiered in 2003, followed by the 40-minute 3D ATASHIn'CHI film in 2010. A new television anime series titled Shin ATASHIn'CHI premiered in October 2015, and ended in April 2016. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

The official YouTube channel for the anime has been streaming the series and Shin ATASHIn'CHI with English subtitles since May 2020.

Shinei Animation and AlphaBoat describe the anime's story:

ATASHIn'CHI ... describes the everyday life of the Tachibana family: Mother, who tries her best in everything she does despite her clumsiness; Father, who says little and insists on doing everything his way; Mikan, a high school romantic; and Yuzuhiko, who might appear to be emotionless at first glance but is quite naïve.

Kera launched a new serialization for the manga titled ATASHIn'CHI SUPER in December 2019, seven years after she originally ended the series. When Kera ended the manga in March 2012, she had been drawing it in the Sunday edition of the Yomiuri Shimbun newspaper since 1994, for 17 years and 10 months.

title: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery New Images Reveal First Look at Nishagora
content:
Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery , the first installment in the franchise’s new theatrical film series, revealed new scene stills, including the first look at the new character Nishagora. The anime is set to premiere in Japan on October 23, 2026. You can see the new images below.

Picking up directly after the events of Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun , the film follows Riko, Reg, Nanachi, and Faputa as they descend into the Abyss’ seventh layer. Kinema Citrus returns as the animation studio, continuing its involvement from the previous entries in the series. The staff includes:

• Animation Production: Kinema Citrus

• Director: Masayuki Kojima

• Screenplay: Hideyuki Kurata

• Character Design: Yuka Kuroda, Kazuchika Kise (Production I.G)

The film’s theme song, “Chain of the Abyss,” is performed by composer Kevin Penkin featuring Mori Calliope. The latest trailer previewed the song, along with introducing Tepasté, voiced by Sumire Morohoshi, and Cravali, voiced by Takanori Hoshino.

Made in Abyss , written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, follows the descent of a girl named Riko and a robot boy named Reg into the Abyss, a massive pit filled with ancient relics and mysterious creatures. The manga is serialized on Takeshobo’s Web Comic Gamma and has over 22 million circulating copies.

A film concert titled Made in Abyss Film Concert: Deep Echoes of Resonance was held today on February 8, 2026 at Tokyo’s Nakano ZERO Grand Hall. Composer Kevin Penkin conducted a live orchestra performing the anime’s soundtrack, accompanied by anime footage on a large screen. Vocalist Ko Saito and KIHOW (MYTH & ROID), who performed the series’ theme songs, also appeared for live performances. Main cast members Miyu Tomita (Riko), Mariya Ise (Reg), and Shiori Izawa (Nanachi) were also present.
author: Anime Corner

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Tenth Ending Featuring "Sakura Rock" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its tenth ending, featuring the song “Sakura Rock” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 115-126, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the sixth opening, featuring the song “EASY GO” by Kazuki Kato . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: 'Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo, Split Cours
content:
The official website for the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen ( Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc ) television anime revealed additional cast members, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Saturday. The second season adapting Yura Urushibara 's action fantasy manga will air in split cours, with the first part debuting on October 2 at 11:30 p.m. on Nippon Television's Friday Anime Night programming block, followed by BS Nippon Television on October 5. The second cours will premiere in April 2027.

Ahead of the premiere, special recap versions of the Kyoto Arc and Nerima Arc will air on Nippon Television on October 1 at 12:35 a.m. and October 2 at 12:35 a.m., respectively, followed by web streaming at 2:05 a.m.

Cast Kusabi Momoura: Kenichi Suzumura ( Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These ) Hizumi Momotsugi: Yuuki Kaji ( Shingeki no Kyojin ) Senritsu Momoo: Kishou Taniyama ( Bungou Stray Dogs )

Japanese idol Hiromitsu Kitayama is performing the opening theme "BACKLASH." Music group TRACK15 is performing the ending theme "Te to Te." Both theme songs are previewed in the first promotional video below.

Ato Nonaka ( Fate/Zero episode director) is returning to direct at Studio Hibari . Yukie Sugawara ( Overlord ) is handling series composition and script. Ryouko Amisaki ( Radiant 2nd Season ) is designing the characters and Kohta Yamamoto ( Mato Seihei no Slave ) is composing the music.

Produced by Studio Hibari, the first season aired in 24 episodes from Summer 2025 to Fall 2025. Crunchyroll and Netflix simulcasted the anime with subtitles in multiple languages.

Urushibara began serializing the manga in Weekly Shounen Champion in June 2020. Akita Shoten published the 30th volume on July 8.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in March 2024 and published the fifth volume on May 26 and will release the sixth volume on November 24.

The second season adapting Yura Urushibara 's action fantasy manga will air in split cours, with the first part debuting on October 2 at 11:30 p.m. on Nippon Television's Friday Anime Night programming block, followed by BS Nippon Television on October 5. The second cours will premiere in April 2027.

Ahead of the premiere, special recap versions of the Kyoto Arc and Nerima Arc will air on Nippon Television on October 1 at 12:35 a.m. and October 2 at 12:35 a.m., respectively, followed by web streaming at 2:05 a.m.
Cast Kusabi Momoura: Kenichi Suzumura ( Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These ) Hizumi Momotsugi: Yuuki Kaji ( Shingeki no Kyojin ) Senritsu Momoo: Kishou Taniyama ( Bungou Stray Dogs )

Japanese idol Hiromitsu Kitayama is performing the opening theme "BACKLASH." Music group TRACK15 is performing the ending theme "Te to Te." Both theme songs are previewed in the first promotional video below.

Ato Nonaka ( Fate/Zero episode director) is returning to direct at Studio Hibari . Yukie Sugawara ( Overlord ) is handling series composition and script. Ryouko Amisaki ( Radiant 2nd Season ) is designing the characters and Kohta Yamamoto ( Mato Seihei no Slave ) is composing the music.
Produced by Studio Hibari, the first season aired in 24 episodes from Summer 2025 to Fall 2025. Crunchyroll and Netflix simulcasted the anime with subtitles in multiple languages.
Urushibara began serializing the manga in Weekly Shounen Champion in June 2020. Akita Shoten published the 30th volume on July 8.
Yen Press licensed the manga in English in March 2024 and published the fifth volume on May 26 and will release the sixth volume on November 24.
